definition.proposition: Looping only the GDN mixer (FFN once per layer) keeps part of full-block recurrence's gain at ~54% of its backbone projection FLOPs: v1 110M keeps 41.5% of the CORE gain (NLL NoLoop 2.401 / MixerLoop 2.377 / FullLoop 2.342); v2 100M reports MixerLoop ≥ FullLoop on CORE (11.24 vs 10.89)
